Rashi on Gittin 45a:10:1.hebrew: לבי כותאי - חו"ל היא, ורב חסדא נמי בבבל הוה. שלח להו: "כן תעשה לכל אבידת אחיך":
Rashi on Gittin 45a:10:1.english: To Bei Kutai - It is outside the Land [of Israel], and Rav Chisda was also in Babylonia. He sent to them: "So shall you do for anything your brother has lost":

Rashi on Gittin 45a:11:1.hebrew: דמשמע להו קראי - פשטיה דקרא הכי משמע להו טפי, והן אינן שומעין לדברי חכמים, להכי לא שלח להו כרבי:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:11:1.english: [Because] the verses imply [this] to them - The plain meaning of the verse implies this to them more, and they do not heed the words of the Sages; therefore, he did not send [a response] to them in accordance with [the view of] Rabbi:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:12:1.hebrew: דנחמני את - כלומר, מכירין אנו בך שחסיד אתה ולא תשקר:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:12:1.english: That you are Naḥmani - That is to say, we know about you that you are a pious man and will not lie:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:13:1.hebrew: מפני תקנת שבויין - בגמ' מפרש לה:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:13:1.english: For the betterment of the captives - In the Gemara, it is explained.

Rashi on Gittin 45a:14:1.english: [Is] it because of the pressure on the community - We should not press the community and bring it to poverty for the sake of these [captives]:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:14:2.hebrew: או דילמא - דלא ימסרו עובדי כוכבים נפשייהו וליגרבו ולייתו טפי, מפני שמוכרין אותן ביוקר. ונפקא מינה: אם יש לו אב עשיר או קרוב שרוצה לפדותו בדמים הרבה ולא יפילהו על הצבור:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:14:2.english: Or perhaps - [it is] so that idolaters will not risk their lives and seize and bring more [captives], because they sell them at a high price. And the practical difference [is] if he has a wealthy father or relative who wants to redeem him for a large sum of money and will not cast him upon the community:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:15:1.english: With thirteen thousand dinars - Evidently, [the ordinance] is because of the burden on the community:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:17:1.hebrew: דליכא אלא חד - שבוי. ת"ק חייש לתיקון העולם כולו, שמא יקצפו על השבויים העתידים לבא ויתנום בשלשלאות ובחריצים; ורבי שמעון לא חייש אלא אם כן יש שבויין אחרים עמו, שמא יקצפו השבאין לייסרן ביסורין:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:17:1.english: When there is only one - captive. The Tanna Kamma is concerned for the betterment of the entire world, lest [the captors] become angry at future captives who will come [into their hands] and place them in chains and fetters; whereas Rabbi Shimon [ben Gamliel] is not concerned unless there are other captives with him, lest the captors become angry and torment them with suffering:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:18:1.hebrew: בחשן קידרא בידייהו - מגיסות הקדרה בידיהן כשהיא רותחת, והרואה סבור שאין האור שולטת בהן, שצדקניות הן:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:18:1.english: [They] would stir a pot with their hands - They stir the pot with their hands while it is boiling, and an onlooker thinks that the fire has no power over them because they are righteous:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:18:2.english: One of a thousand I have found - [meaning] that he is righteous:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:19:1.english: He said to him - Rav Ilish [said] to that man:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:19:2.english: What is she saying - that raven:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:1:1.hebrew: ורב ענן - דלא ידע בהי מנייהו אמר, ברייתא דלעיל לא הוה שמיע ליה דלפשוט מינה:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:1:1.english: And Rav Anan - who did not know regarding which of them [Shmuel] stated [this], had not heard the baraita [cited] above so that he could resolve [his uncertainty] from it:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:20:1.hebrew: כיונה מתילא - כיונה נמשלה, דכתיב "יונתי תמתי" (שיר השירים ה):
Rashi on Gittin 45a:20:1.english: Is compared to a dove - [The Congregation of Israel] is likened to a dove, as it is written: "My dove, my perfect one" (Song of Songs 5):

Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:1.english: They arrange [their matters] to each other - They consult together in the bathroom:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:2.english: These are our husbands - These captors are our husbands:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:3.hebrew: ונהרדעי גוברין - ישראלים, אנשינו שבנהרדעא, בעלינו היו; כלומר: כשם שהם היו בעלינו, כך אלו בעלינו — אין אנו צריכין עוד להם:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:3.english: And the men of Nehardea [are] husbands - [The] Israelites, our men who are in Nehardea, were our husbands; that is to say, just as they were our husbands, so [too] are these [captors] our husbands — we no longer need them:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:4.hebrew: עדי - אלו, כמו: "עדא אמרה" — "זאת אומרת" (פסחים דף נג:):
Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:4.english: Adei - [This means] "these," as in "ada amrah" — [meaning] "this says" (Pesachim 53b):

Rashi on Gittin 45a:21:5.english: To distance them from here - [Meaning,] that they should distance us from here:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:22:1.english: He and that man - Rav Ilish and that man who understood the language of birds:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:22:2.hebrew: עבר מברא - מעבר המים, ולא יכלו להשיגו עוד:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:22:2.english: He crossed [on] a ferry - [i.e.,] a crossing of the water, and [so] they could no longer overtake him:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:2:1.hebrew: ואי מדשמואל - וא"ת, לפשוט מדשמואל דאמר אינה מכורה כל עיקר, אלמא כיון דלאו מכר הוא, מעות חוזרין:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:2:1.english: And if [one would resolve it] from Shmuel - And if you should say: Let him resolve [the dilemma] from Shmuel, who said [that] it is not sold at all — thus, since it is not a sale, the money is returned:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:2:2.hebrew: ממאי דאינה מכורה ומעות חוזרין דילמא אינה מכורה - לענין דפרישית לעיל, ומעות מתנה:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:2:2.english: From where [can you assume] that it is not sold and the money is returned? Perhaps it is not sold - regarding [the matter] that I explained above, and the money is a gift:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:2:3.hebrew: רב אמר מעות - של קידושין חוזרין, דאדם יודע שאין קידושין תופסין באחותו, וגמר ונתן לשם פקדון:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:2:3.english: Rav said: The money - of betrothal is returned, for a person knows that betrothal does not take effect with his sister, and [therefore] he resolved and gave [it] as a deposit:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:3:1.english: What did you see - regarding the sale of the slave, that you penalize the purchaser:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:3:2.english: The hole - the hole in the wall into which the mouse enters and is saved from its pursuers:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:3:3.english: From where would the hole have - the stolen item:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:4:1.english: Where the forbidden [item] is - And behold, the slave is in the buyer's possession:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:5:1.hebrew: אבתריה - להשיבו בחזקה: ה"ג: "מפקענא ליה מינך מדרבי אחי ברבי יאשיה":
Rashi on Gittin 45a:5:1.english: After him - to bring him back by force. This is the [correct] reading: "I will remove him from you based on [the statement of] Rabbi Achai, son of Rabbi Yoshiya":

Rashi on Gittin 45a:6:1.english: They shall not dwell in your land - It is written regarding the seven nations [of Canaan]:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:6:2.hebrew: אל אדוניו - אל תוציאוהו מביניכם להשיבו לעבודת כוכבים שלו: הכי גרסינן: "וקשיא ליה לרבי יאשיה":
Rashi on Gittin 45a:6:2.english: To his master - Do not expel him from among you to return him to his idol worship. Thus is the reading: "And it is difficult for Rabbi Yoshiyah":

Rashi on Gittin 45a:7:1.hebrew: במוכר עבדו לחוצה לארץ - כאן הזהיר הכתוב לבית דין שאם מכרו, לא יסגירנו ללוקח אלא יצא לחירות. הכי גרסינן: "קשיא ליה לרבי אחי ברבי יאשיה":
Rashi on Gittin 45a:7:1.english: Of one who sells his slave outside the Land [of Israel] - Here Scripture warned the court that if he sold him, it should not hand him over to the buyer; rather, he goes free. This is how we read [the text]: "It is difficult for Rabbi Achi, son of Rabbi Yoshiya":

Rashi on Gittin 45a:8:1.hebrew: מעמך מיבעי ליה - אשר יתפרש מעמך, מן ארץ ישראל, להוציאו לחו"ל, כמו "אשר הציל אלהים מאבינו" (בראשית ל״א:ט״ז):
Rashi on Gittin 45a:8:1.english: [Who escaped] from you, it should have [stated] - [meaning] who will be separated from you, from the Land of Israel, to take him out to outside the Land [of Israel], like [the verse], "which God took away from our father" (Genesis 31:16):

Rashi on Gittin 45a:8:2.hebrew: שברח מחו"ל לארץ - דהיינו "אשר ינצל אליך", לארץ:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:8:2.english: Who escaped from outside the Land to the Land - That is [the meaning of] "who escapes to you" — [to] the Land [of Israel]:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:9:1.hebrew: ע"מ לשחררו - והזהיר הכתוב לבית דין שיכפוהו שלא להשתעבד בו:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:9:1.english: In order to emancipate him - And Scripture warned the court to compel him not to subjugate him:

Rashi on Gittin 45a:9:2.hebrew: הרי עצמך קנוי לך מעכשיו - לכשאקחך, וכי זבין ליה הו"ל משוחרר למפרע, ומהכא אמרי' ביבמות (דף צג:) דרבי כרבי מאיר סבירא ליה, דאמר: אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם:
Rashi on Gittin 45a:9:2.english: You are hereby acquired to yourself from now - [meaning,] when I will purchase you, and when he purchases him, he becomes emancipated retroactively; and from here we say in Yevamot (93b) that Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] holds in accordance with Rabbi Meir, who says: A person can transfer ownership of something that has not yet come into existence:

Tosafot on Gittin 45a:14:1.hebrew: דלא ליגרבו ולייתו - והא דתניא בפ' נערה (כתובות נב.): "נשבית והיו מבקשין ממנה עד עשרה בדמיה, פעם ראשון פודה" — שאני אשתו, דהויא כגופו, יותר מבתו דהכא. ועל עצמו לא תיקנו שלא יתן כל אשר לו בעד נפשו. ור' יהושע בן חנניא דפרקיה לההוא תינוק בממון הרבה בהניזקין (לקמן גיטין דף נח.) — לפי שהיה מופלג בחכמה; אי נמי: בשעת חורבן הבית לא שייך "דלא ליגרבו":
Tosafot on Gittin 45a:14:1.english: So that they will not seize and bring [additional captives] - And [as for] that which was taught in a Baraita in the chapter [entitled] Na'arah (Ketubot 52a): "[If] she was taken captive, and they were demanding for her up to ten times her value, the first time he redeems [her]" — his wife is different, as she is like his own body, more so than his daughter [in the case] here. And regarding oneself, [the Sages] did not enact that one may not give all that he has for his life. And [as for] Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ḥananya, who redeemed that child for a large sum of money, in [the chapter entitled] HaNizakin (below, Gittin 58a) — [that was] because he was distinguished in wisdom; alternatively, at the time of the destruction of the Temple, [the concern] "so that they will not seize [more]" does not apply:

Tosafot on Gittin 45a:2:1.hebrew: מידי דהוה אמקדש אחותו - ולפי האמת יש לחלק, דלא שייך התם למימר "אדם יודע" כמו במקדש אחותו, דהא רב קאמר דמכורה ויוצאה:
Tosafot on Gittin 45a:2:1.english: Just as it is in [the case of] one who betroths his sister - And in truth, one can distinguish [between the cases], for it is not applicable there [in the case of the sale] to say "a person knows [that the transaction does not take effect]" as [it is] in [the case of] one who betroths his sister, since Rav says that she is sold and goes free:
